functions.name: list-activity-metrics
functions.description: Return one page of activity performance metrics for a reporting interval, optionally restricted to selected agents.

startAt.description: Beginning of the reporting interval, with explicit UTC marker or offset and at most millisecond precision.

endAt.description: End of the reporting interval, later than startAt, with explicit offset and at most millisecond precision. Provider boundary inclusion is retained.

limit.description: Maximum records in this page; defaults to 500.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for this query; omit for the first page.

agentEmails.description: Agent email addresses whose data contributes to the report. Omit for no email filter; null and empty arrays are not accepted.

items.description: Agent email address, preserved verbatim and excluding commas.

includeDeletedAgents.description: Whether deleted agents contribute to the report; defaults to false.

FunctionInput_dialpad_wfm_listactivityme.description: Reporting interval, optional agent filters, and continuation for one page of activity metrics.

startAt.description: Beginning of this metric interval in UTC, preserving precision.

endAt.description: End of this metric interval in UTC, preserving precision.

activityName.description: Activity display name; null if explicitly unavailable.

activityType.description: Provider activity classification, preserved without treating it as an identifier; null if unavailable.

scheduledHours.description: Scheduled duration in hours; null when unavailable.

timeOnTask.description: Provider time-on-task fraction, not percentage points; null when unavailable.

conversationsOpened.description: Reported conversations opened in the interval; null when unavailable.

conversationsCommentedOn.description: Reported conversations commented on; null when unavailable.

conversationsOnHold.description: Provider conversations-on-hold count; null when unavailable.

conversationsClosed.description: Reported conversations closed; null when unavailable.

averageInteractionTime.description: Provider average interaction time, preserved in its original numeric unit because that unit is not documented; null when unavailable.

averageConversationTime.description: Provider average conversation time, preserved in its original numeric unit because that unit is not documented; null when unavailable.

wrongTaskSnapshots.description: Provider count of wrong-task snapshots; null when unavailable.

conversationsClosedPerHour.description: Conversation closure rate per hour; null when unavailable.

adherenceScore.description: Provider adherence score without rescaling; null when unavailable.

timeInAdherence.description: Time and share in adherence; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

seconds.description: Duration in seconds; null when unavailable.

fraction.description: Provider percentage represented as a fraction, for example 0.9333; null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: Provider duration in seconds and its reported fractional share.

timeOutOfAdherence.description: Time and share out of adherence; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

seconds.description: Duration in seconds; null when unavailable.

fraction.description: Provider percentage represented as a fraction, for example 0.9333; null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: Provider duration in seconds and its reported fractional share.

timeInException.description: Time and share in exception; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

seconds.description: Duration in seconds; null when unavailable.

fraction.description: Provider percentage represented as a fraction, for example 0.9333; null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: Provider duration in seconds and its reported fractional share.

items.description: One activity performance record for the exact interval returned by the provider.
One page of activity metric intervals in provider order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same query; omitted when exhausted.

FunctionOutput_dialpad_wfm_listactivitym.description: One page of activity metrics and an optional opaque continuation.

tags.instructions: Use for on-demand activity performance reporting. Supply an interval and optional known agent emails. Continue by passing `nextCursor` as `cursor` with the same interval, filters, and limit. Each call returns at most 500 records. Use `list-daily-activity-metrics` only for calendar-day buckets in a named timezone; that reporting endpoint is deprecated.

functions.name: list-agent-metrics
functions.description: Return one page of agent performance metrics for a reporting interval, optionally filtered by agent emails.

startAt.description: Beginning of the reporting interval, with explicit UTC marker or offset and at most millisecond precision.

endAt.description: End of the reporting interval, later than startAt, with explicit offset and at most millisecond precision. Boundary inclusion follows the provider.

limit.description: Maximum records in this page; defaults to 500.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from the previous page of this same query. Omit for the first page.

agentEmails.description: Agent email addresses to include. Omit to apply no email filter; an empty list and null are not accepted.

includeDeletedAgents.description: Whether to include deleted agents; defaults to false.

FunctionInput_dialpad_wfm_listagentmetri.description: Reporting interval, optional agent filters, and pagination for one page of agent performance metrics.

startAt.description: Beginning of this metric interval, normalized to UTC without precision loss.

endAt.description: End of this metric interval, normalized to UTC without precision loss.

agentName.description: Agent display name; null if the provider explicitly reports null.

agentEmail.description: Agent email identifying the reported agent; null if explicitly unavailable.

scheduledHours.description: Scheduled duration in hours; null when unavailable.

utilisation.description: Provider utilisation fraction, not percentage points; null when unavailable.

totalConversationsClosed.description: Total conversations closed in this interval; null when unavailable.

conversationsClosedPerHour.description: Provider conversation closure rate per hour; null when unavailable.

conversationsClosedPerServiceHour.description: Provider conversation closure rate per service hour; null when unavailable.

timeOnTask.description: Provider time-on-task fraction, not percentage points; null when unavailable.

occupancy.description: Provider occupancy fraction, not percentage points; null when unavailable.

adherenceScore.description: Provider adherence score, preserved without rescaling; null when unavailable.

plannedOccupancy.description: Provider planned occupancy share and lost seconds; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

fraction.description: Occupancy percentage represented as a fraction; null when unavailable.

secondsLost.description: Lost time in seconds, as reported by the provider; null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: Provider occupancy share and lost time.

actualOccupancy.description: Provider actual occupancy share and lost seconds; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

fraction.description: Occupancy percentage represented as a fraction; null when unavailable.

secondsLost.description: Lost time in seconds, as reported by the provider; null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: Provider occupancy share and lost time.

timeInAdherence.description: Reported time and share in adherence; omitted if absent upstream and null if explicitly null.

seconds.description: Duration in seconds; null when unavailable.

fraction.description: Provider percentage represented as a fraction, for example 0.9333, not percentage points; null when unavailable.

timeOutOfAdherence.description: Reported time and share out of adherence; omitted if absent upstream and null if explicitly null.

seconds.description: Duration in seconds; null when unavailable.

fraction.description: Provider percentage represented as a fraction, for example 0.9333, not percentage points; null when unavailable.

timeInException.description: Reported time and share in exception; omitted if absent upstream and null if explicitly null.

seconds.description: Duration in seconds; null when unavailable.

fraction.description: Provider percentage represented as a fraction, for example 0.9333, not percentage points; null when unavailable.

items.description: This page of agent metric intervals, in provider order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same query; omitted when exhausted.

FunctionOutput_dialpad_wfm_listagentmetr.description: One page of agent performance metrics and an optional continuation cursor.

tags.instructions: Use for on-demand agent performance reporting. Supply a reporting interval and, optionally, agent emails you already know. Pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` with the same interval, filters, and limit to continue. Each call returns at most 500 records. Use `list-daily-agent-metrics` only when you need calendar-day buckets in a named timezone; that reporting endpoint is deprecated.

functions.name: list-daily-activity-metrics
functions.description: Return activity performance metrics in timezone-local calendar-day buckets using the deprecated daily reporting endpoint.

endAt.description: End instant, later than startAt and at most 90 elapsed days after it, with explicit offset and at most millisecond precision.

startAt.description: Start instant with explicit offset and at most millisecond precision.

timezone.description: IANA zone controlling daily aggregation; defaults to Etc/UTC.

agentEmails.description: Agent email addresses whose data contributes to the report. Omit for no email filter; null and empty arrays are not accepted.

items.description: An agent email address without commas, preserved exactly as supplied.

includeDeletedAgents.description: Whether deleted agents contribute to the report. Explicitly defaults to false in this tool; the legacy provider default is unspecified.

FunctionInput_dialpad_wfm_listdailyactiv.description: A bounded instant range and optional filters for provider-computed daily activity reporting.

date.description: Local calendar date in the result timezone, not an instant.

timeOnTask.description: Time-on-task fraction, for example 0.505 for 50.5%; null when unavailable.

activityName.description: Activity display name; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

activityType.description: Provider activity classification preserved verbatim; null if unavailable.

adherenceScore.description: Provider adherence score preserved without rescaling; null when unavailable.

scheduledHours.description: Scheduled duration in hours; null when unavailable.

timeInAdherence.description: Time and fraction in adherence; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

seconds.description: Reported duration in seconds; null when unavailable.

fraction.description: Reported percentage represented as a fraction, not percentage points; null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: Provider-reported duration and its share of time.

timeInException.description: Time and fraction in exception; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

seconds.description: Reported duration in seconds; null when unavailable.

fraction.description: Reported percentage represented as a fraction, not percentage points; null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: Provider-reported duration and its share of time.

timeOutOfAdherence.description: Time and fraction out of adherence; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

seconds.description: Reported duration in seconds; null when unavailable.

fraction.description: Reported percentage represented as a fraction, not percentage points; null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: Provider-reported duration and its share of time.

wrongTaskSnapshots.description: Reported wrong-task snapshot count; null when unavailable.

conversationsClosed.description: Reported conversations closed; null when unavailable.

conversationsOnHold.description: Provider conversations-on-hold count; null when unavailable.

conversationsOpened.description: Reported conversations opened; null when unavailable.

averageInteractionTime.description: Provider average interaction time in its unspecified original numeric unit; null when unavailable.

averageConversationTime.description: Provider average conversation time in its unspecified original numeric unit; null when unavailable.

conversationsCommentedOn.description: Reported conversations commented on; null when unavailable.

conversationsClosedPerHour.description: Provider conversation closure rate per hour; null when unavailable.

items.description: All returned daily activity buckets flattened in provider order.

timezone.description: Effective IANA zone in which each bucket date is interpreted.

FunctionOutput_dialpad_wfm_listdailyacti.description: Complete daily activity report in the effective aggregation timezone.

tags.instructions: Use only for provider-computed daily buckets in a named timezone. Prefer `list-activity-metrics` for new interval-based reporting. Supply a range of at most 90 elapsed days and optional known agent emails. The result is one complete provider response without pagination.

functions.name: list-daily-agent-metrics
functions.description: Return agent performance metrics in calendar-day buckets for a selected timezone. Uses the deprecated daily reporting endpoint; prefer interval-based agent metrics for new reporting.

startAt.description: Start instant with explicit offset and at most millisecond precision. This is not a date-only bucket label.

endAt.description: End instant, later than startAt and at most 90 elapsed days after it, with explicit offset and at most millisecond precision.

timezone.description: IANA timezone controlling the provider's calendar-day buckets; defaults to Etc/UTC.

agentEmails.description: Agent emails to include; omit for no email filter. Null and empty lists are not accepted.

items.description: Agent email to include, without commas.

includeDeletedAgents.description: Whether to include deleted agents. This tool explicitly defaults to false; the deprecated provider endpoint does not document its default.

FunctionInput_dialpad_wfm_listdailyagent.description: A bounded reporting interval, optional agent filters, and the timezone for daily aggregation.

date.description: Calendar date of this bucket in the result timezone, not a UTC instant.

agentName.description: Agent display name; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

occupancy.description: Occupancy fraction, for example 0.455 for 45.5%; null when unavailable.

agentEmail.description: Agent email; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

timeOnTask.description: Time-on-task fraction, for example 0.505 for 50.5%; null when unavailable.

utilisation.description: Utilisation fraction, for example 0.505 for 50.5%; null when unavailable.

scheduledHours.description: Scheduled duration in hours; null when unavailable.

totalConversationsClosed.description: Total reported conversations closed for the day; null when unavailable.

conversationsClosedPerHour.description: Reported conversation closure rate per hour; null when unavailable.

conversationsClosedPerServiceHour.description: Reported conversation closure rate per service hour; null when unavailable.

items.description: One provider-computed calendar-day bucket for an agent.
All returned daily agent buckets, flattened from the provider's grouped response and retaining its order.

timezone.description: Effective IANA timezone in which items[].date is interpreted.

FunctionOutput_dialpad_wfm_listdailyagen.description: The complete daily agent report and its effective calendar timezone, without continuation.

tags.instructions: Use only when you need the provider's timezone-local daily aggregation. For current interval-based reporting use `list-agent-metrics`. Supply a range of at most 90 elapsed days and optional known agent emails. This returns the provider's whole response in one page, with no continuation.

functions.name: list-schedule-entries
functions.description: Return one page of the published schedule, including shifts, scheduled tasks, and time off within a reporting interval.

endAt.description: End of the requested interval, later than startAt, with explicit offset and at most millisecond precision. Provider overlap and boundary rules apply.

limit.description: Maximum top-level entries per page. Defaults to 100; this tool conservatively caps requests at the documented provider default.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for the unchanged schedule query; omit for the first page.

startAt.description: Beginning of the requested interval, with explicit UTC marker or offset and at most millisecond precision.

includeDeletedAgents.description: Whether to include schedules for deleted agents; defaults to true, matching the provider.

FunctionInput_dialpad_wfm_listscheduleen.description: Reporting interval and pagination options for the published schedule.

type.description: Provider schedule-entry classification, currently illustrated as shift or time-off; not an invented resource identifier.

endAt.description: End of the schedule entry in UTC, preserving precision and provider endpoint meaning.

tasks.description: Ordered task segments within a shift; omitted if absent, null if explicitly null, and empty if explicitly empty.

type.description: Provider task classification, such as activity, break, or blocked-time; not a closed enum.

endAt.description: End of this scheduled task segment in UTC, preserving precision.

taskId.description: Opaque referenced task identifier, omitted when the provider supplies none, as in the blocked-time example.

startAt.description: Beginning of this scheduled task segment in UTC, preserving precision.

ticketGroups.description: Ticket groups attached to the scheduled task; omitted if absent, and empty if explicitly empty.

id.description: Opaque ticket-group identifier in the connected system context.

connectedTicketingSystem.description: Provider name of the connected ticketing system, such as zendesk.

items.description: Ticket-group reference in the connected system.
Ordered scheduled task segment within a shift.

agentId.description: Opaque scheduled agent identifier from surfer.id.

startAt.description: Beginning of the schedule entry in UTC, preserving precision.

subtype.description: Provider time-off subtype, for example Holiday; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

agentEmail.description: Scheduled agent email; omitted if absent and null if explicitly unavailable.

remoteSubtype.description: Time-off subtype from the connected external system, for example Annual Leave; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

shiftTemplate.description: Shift-template reference for a shift; omitted if absent and null if explicitly null.

items.description: Published shift or time-off entry with its original interval.
This page of published schedule entries in provider order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same query; omitted when no next page exists.

FunctionOutput_dialpad_wfm_listschedulee.description: One page of the published schedule and its optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use to inspect published shifts and time off without maintaining a replicated schedule. Supply the interval you need. Deleted agents' schedules are included by default; set includeDeletedAgents=false to exclude them. Continue by passing `nextCursor` as `cursor` with the same interval, inclusion choice, and limit. Each call returns at most 100 top-level schedule entries; task segments remain nested within their shift.
